description: Per-target calibrator configuration for research-writing-harness-claude. Declares the runtime-artefact surfaces that consuming projects create at harness invocation time so the calibrator's md_dead_references and changelog_path_references_resolve rules treat them as intentional pointers rather than dead links. Consumed by plugin-calibrator v0.5.4+ via plugin_calibrator.quality._load_target_allow_list.

notes.rationale: The harness is a consuming-project contract: skills and agent files reference artefacts that the harness itself does not ship but that every consuming project materializes under these paths during T1 Plan & Draft onward. Flagging them as broken links misrepresents the contract and would force the author to either ship placeholder artefacts or accept permanent MAJOR findings.
notes.date_templates: YYYY-MM-DD and YYYYMMDD placeholders are exempted by the calibrator's built-in _contains_date_template check; no additional configuration needed for dated filenames (e.g. reviews/t3_YYYY-MM-DD_pass.md).
notes.scope: This allow-list applies only to md_dead_references and changelog_path_references_resolve rules. All other deterministic checks (parity, grounding, contract) remain fully active.
